input.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for Customer to use, modify and sublicense Developed Software, and limit M&I's use of Customer Data to processing solely to provide the Services.
input.comment: [Playbook] M&I keeps ownership of everything it develops, even work we pay for, and our rights expire with the Term, so we have added the playbook fallback licence (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, including modification and sublicensing) to the Developed Software and limited M&I's use of Customer Data to processing it solely to provide the Services.

ops.oldText: Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data.
ops.newText: Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data and except that Customer shall have a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software (as defined in Section 10.4) for Customer's business.

ops.oldText: shall not disclose or use such Confidential Information other than for the purposes contemplated by this Agreement,
ops.newText: shall not disclose or use such Confidential Information other than for the purposes contemplated by this Agreement, provided that M&I shall not use Customer Data other than to process it solely to provide the Services,
